name: Swimm
tagline: Swimm is a code documentation platform with AI that keeps docs automatically synced with code changes. When code is modified, Swimm detects affected documentation and flags it for update or auto-updates it. Engineering teams use it to maintain living documentation that developers actually read because it is always current.
